scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SESSION_SECRET.description: HMAC key for stored token hashes and CSRF tokens. 32 random bytes, base64url without padding: `openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n'`

NOTE_KEK.description: Wraps each client's note key. 32 random bytes, standard base64: `openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '\n'`. Losing it loses every note; keep a copy offline.

BACKUP_RECIPIENT.description: The age public key (age1...) the nightly backup is encrypted to. Make one with: `age-keygen -o backup-key.txt; age-keygen -y backup-key.txt`. Keep the identity file offline.

SSO_PROVIDERS.description: Optional. Leave empty (off). Anything else must be a JSON array of providers, or the deploy fails; see ARCHITECTURE, Deploy.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One time: lets /setup create the first admin on an empty database; delete it after. `openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n'`

NOTE_KEK_PREVIOUS.description: Optional. Leave empty (off). Set only during a key rotation.

BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.description: Off-account backup copy, needed while BACKUP_COPY is s3 (wrangler.jsonc): see ARCHITECTURE, Deploy, With the button. Without it the nightly backup fails and /healthz answers 503.
